ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the Arctic (north of 66.5N) changed by +0.858 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.806 to +0.910), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 2.117 °C.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Arctic (north of 66.5N) shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.50): the estimate is +0.0017 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0032 to +0.0066). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
